teaser.en: The 'guava of the forest': not a guava at all, but a forest shrub that reminds people of one.
teaser.sw: 'Mpera wa msituni': si mpera hata kidogo, bali ni kichaka cha msituni kinachowakumbusha watu mpera.
teaser.dg: 'Mpera wa tsakani': si mpera hata chidide, ela ni chitsaka cha tsakani chinachotambukiza atu mpera.

summary.en: Mpera wa tsakani is a shrub or small tree of the coffee family, seen by Digo speakers as the forest form of the guava. It shares its name with Vismia orientalis.
summary.sw: Mpera wa tsakani ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya mibuni, ambao Wadigo huuona kuwa aina ya msituni ya mpera. Unashiriki jina lake na Vismia orientalis.
summary.dg: *Mpera wa tsakani* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya kahawa, ambao atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuuona dza aina ya tsakani ya mpera. Dzina hiri ra Chidigo rinahumirwa piya kpwa Vismia orientalis.

about.en:
*Mpera wa tsakani* is a shrub or small tree of the coffee family. It has large, broad, opposite leaves, which is what *platyphylla*, 'broad-leaved', refers to. Like other *Leptactina*, it has showy white flowers with long, slender tubes and narrow, spreading lobes, often fragrant.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves, which explains the comparison with the guava.
about.sw:
*Mpera wa tsakani* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya mibuni. Una majani makubwa, mapana yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, na hiyo ndiyo maana ya *platyphylla*, 'wenye majani mapana'. Kama *Leptactina* wengine, una maua meupe ya kuvutia yenye mirija mirefu myembamba na ncha nyembamba za petali zinazotandaa, mara nyingi yenye harufu nzuri.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake, jambo linaloeleza kwa nini unalinganishwa na mpera.
about.dg:
*Mpera wa tsakani* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya kahawa. Una makodza makulu na mapana ganayolengana mairi-mairi, na ndiyo mana ya *platyphylla*, 'wenye makodza mapana'. Dza *Leptactina* zanjina, una maruwa mereru ganayoonekana sana, genye mirija mire na myembamba na seemu nyembamba zinazotawanyika, na mara nyinji genye arufu nono.

Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaumanya kpwa makodzage, na ndiyo sababu unalinganishwa na mpera.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket in East Africa.
where.sw: Unaota katika misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani Afrika Mashariki.

culture.en: This is one of several Digo names built with *wa tsakani*, 'of the forest', which mark a wild forest form of a familiar planted or common plant. *Muasmini wa tsakani* is another example: it is the forest form of jasmine.
culture.sw: Hili ni mojawapo ya majina kadhaa ya Kidigo yaliyoundwa kwa *wa tsakani*, 'wa msituni', ambayo huashiria aina pori ya msituni ya mmea unaojulikana, unaopandwa au wa kawaida. *Muasmini wa tsakani* ni mfano mwingine: ni aina ya msituni ya yasmini.
culture.dg: Hiri ni dzina mwenga kahi ya madzina manji ga Chidigo ganayodzengbwa kpwa maneno *wa tsakani*, ganayoonyesa aina ya tsakani ya mmea unaomanyikana, uwe wa kuphandwa au wa kawaida. *Muasmini wa tsakani* ni mfwano wanjina: ni aina ya tsakani ya *muasmini*.

names.en: *Mpera wa tsakani* means '*mpera* in the forest'. Pakia records that the species is seen as the forest type of *mpera*, the guava (*Psidium guajava*). It is not related to the guava. Pakia uses the same name for *Vismia orientalis*. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mpera wa tsakani* maana yake ni '*mpera* wa msituni'. Pakia anaandika kwamba spishi hii inaonwa kuwa aina ya msituni ya *mpera*, yaani mpera (*Psidium guajava*). Hauna uhusiano na mpera. Pakia hutumia jina hilo hilo kwa *Vismia orientalis*. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Mana ya *mpera wa tsakani* ni '*mpera* wa tsakani'. Pakia anaandika kukala aina ihi inaonekana dza aina ya tsakani ya *mpera* (*Psidium guajava*). Si ndugu wa mpera. Pakia anahumira dzina hiri piya kpwa *Vismia orientalis*. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.
